findings.note: Rotowire says Allen scored 27 points on 6 threes in 34 minutes in the Nov 10 win over Cleveland, his third game of 22 or more points in about a week. He averaged 17.6 points in 27 starts last season, and the page lists him at 15.3 points per game this season.

ESPN lists Allen at 14.1 points per game over 25.9 minutes in his first 10 games. In his first start, a 119-80 blowout loss to Boston on Nov 6, he scored 0 points in 22 minutes, and the game log swings widely (5, 27, 11, 22, 0).

Allen moved into the starting lineup on Nov 6 only because Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Dennis Schroder (thigh) were out. Whether either returns against Phoenix will affect his minutes and shots. No status update for this game was found, and Allen is facing his former team.
